thread:
lee: heads-up — multiple CI promotes for v1.3.7-rc2 are failing at finalize with size/hash mismatches and remote-cache lease errors starting ~14:10 UTC.

maria: runners show: `finalize multipart: expected=10485760 got=10485587` and deploy-bot returns `409 Conflict: lease held by writer-21`.

qa-bot: artifact-verify failed for pkg v1.3.7-rc2 (size delta). seen on ci-runner-3 and ci-runner-18.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation: throttle remote-cache writers and increase finalize timeout. quick patch: ```kubectl -n infra patch cm cache-cfg -p '{"data":{"max_writers":"4","finalize_timeout_s":"90"}}'``` I'll watch lease_conflicts and finalize_errors for 10m.

lee: change window is tight today (partner demo 16:00). ops prefers not to delay. two options: 1) pin to last-green (sha: e3b7f1) and promote; 2) hold until storage stabilizes. Maria/QA, which do we prefer?

maria: if last-green passed identical canaries yesterday, pinning is fine. we'll need release-note copy and a follow-up incident.

qa-bot: quick check: last-green e3b7f1 passed smoke and canary yesterday (3/3). safe to pin if we update notes.

release-coordinator: creating RD-9999 to track storage multipart finalization. will link to release and notify support if we pin. docs: https://tracker.internal/rd/9999 (placeholder).

sre-oncall: throttle applied; metrics show lease_conflicts down from ~140/min to ~9/min after 90s. green to promote pinned build.

lee: ok proceeding with manual promote to e3b7f1 to avoid demo delay. can someone run the promote and watch canaries? I'll prepare release-note blurb.

maria: running manual promote now. will abort if any canary reports artifact mismatch.

deploy-bot: manual promote started by maria at 1747210250; step1 snapshot -> success; step2 upload -> success; step3 canary rollout -> 3/3 healthy at 1747210275; step4 finalize -> pending. will post final status.

lee: thanks all. release-note line drafted: "Promoted previous green build e3b7f1 due to artifact finalize failures for v1.3.7-rc2; investigation under RD-9999."

deploy-bot: finalize completed by maria at 1747210285; promote finished. closing thread when RD-9999 is linked.
